facts.business: Conart Engineers Limited engages in fixed-price contracts, recognizing revenue using the percentage of completion method based on the input method.
key_risks: Revenue recognition under IND AS 115 for fixed-price contracts involves complex judgments and estimates, including identifying performance obligations and recognizing revenue based on stage of completion on certified invoices.
Raw materials are subject to domestic price variations and, for imported raw materials, price variations and foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
facts.related_party_note: The Company does not have any Subsidiary Company and it has not given any loans or advances in the nature of loan to firms/companies in which directors are interested in contravention of any provisions of Companies Act, 2013.
